blocks.text: Maris Racal, Odette Khan, Carlo Aquino and Jericho Rosales tied for top acting honors at the 2026 Gawad Urian, with two winners each in the Best Actress and Best Actor categories. Racal won Best Actress for “Sunshine,” while Khan received the same honor for “Bar Boys: After School.” After the ceremony, Racal took to Instagram to celebrate her win, writing, “MAY URIAN NA AKO!!!! Maraming Salamat PAPA GOD!” alongside photos of her posing with the trophy.
